high.label: Lavish wedding
high.diary: We had a lavish wedding. I'll never forget our guests' smiles.

mid.label: Standard wedding
mid.diary: We had a simple but heartfelt wedding.

low.label: Courthouse + small party
low.diary: We married at the courthouse and threw a small party with friends.

wedding.skip: We skipped the ceremony and shared a quiet toast, just the two of us.

high.label: Europe
high.diary: Honeymoon in Europe. We walked cobblestone streets hand in hand.

mid.label: Hawaii
mid.diary: Honeymoon in Hawaii. The sunsets were beautiful.

low.label: Road trip
low.diary: Our honeymoon was a road trip down the coast. We sang the whole way.

honeymoon.skip: We skipped the honeymoon. "Someday," we promised.

high.diary: We decided we'd both work full-time.

mid.diary: My partner switched to shorter hours / part-time.

low.diary: My partner left work to focus on home.

high.label: Luxury car
high.diary: We bought a luxury car. Driving it makes us sit up straight.

mid.label: New car
mid.diary: We bought a new car. Weekend drives became our joy.

low.label: Used car
low.diary: We bought a used car. A bit old, but it runs fine.

car.skip: We didn't buy a car. Buses and rideshares will do.
car.never: We decided to live without a car.

high.label: Nanny / premium center
high.diary: We hired a nanny and signed up for lots of classes.

mid.diary: We found a spot at a daycare center.

low.label: Grandparents
low.diary: The grandparents will look after them. They're thrilled.

high.label: Private
high.diary: Started at a private elementary school. The uniform looks great.

mid.label: Public + activities
mid.diary: Started at public elementary school, plus sports and lessons.

low.label: Public
low.diary: Started at public elementary school. The backpack looks huge.

high.label: Private
high.diary: Started at a private middle school.

mid.label: Public + tutoring
mid.diary: Started public middle school and began tutoring.

low.label: Public
low.diary: Started public middle school. Totally into after-school sports.

high.label: Private
high.diary: Started at a private high school.

mid.label: Public + test prep
mid.diary: Started public high school, with SAT prep too.

mid.diary: Went to the in-state university. ({years} yrs)

low.label: Community college first
low.diary: Started at community college, then transferred. ({years} yrs)

university.skip: Got a job after high school. A working adult from summer.

high.label: Large new house
high.diary: We bought a big new house. We talked over the floor plan again and again.

mid.label: Existing house
mid.diary: We bought a house in a quiet neighborhood. We love the backyard.

low.label: Fixer-upper
low.diary: We bought a fixer-upper and fixed it ourselves. Old, but full of charm.

house.skip: We didn't buy; we moved to a bigger rental.
house.never: We decided to rent for life. Traveling light is best.
house.majorRepair: The fixer-upper's plumbing and roof gave out. Major renovation cost {cost:money}.

high.label: Full renovation
high.diary: We renovated the whole house. That'll hold for a while.

low.label: Quick fix
low.diary: We patched it up for now.

high.label: Trip abroad
high.diary: We took a family trip abroad.

mid.label: National park trip
mid.diary: We took a family trip to a national park.

low.label: Day trip nearby
low.diary: We went on a day trip nearby. Still fun.

familyTrip.skip: We spent this year's anniversary relaxing at home.

S.comment: No more money worries. Let's go wherever we always wanted, whenever we like.

A.comment: Hobbies and travel to enjoy. We can laugh and say, "We did well."

B.comment: No luxuries, but no troubles either. Calm days go on.

C.comment: Social Security alone feels thin. We'll get by together, saving where we can.

D.comment: We'll keep working a while. While we're able, that's not so bad.

bankrupt.comment: Debts piled up and our finances collapsed. Look back at where we overreached, and try again.
